notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.3.9

New
- Coding history, all new: modules on the left (with search; modules that never changed are folded away), each version as a chip with its date and number of changes, and a Setting | Before | After table with a "Changed only" switch. "By date" shows every change of a day. "Go back to this version" opens it in the FDL-Editor; nothing is written to the car from here.
- Compare two coding files, Re-apply my coding and NCD compare use the same clear Before (red) / After (green) colours.
- E-Sys errors in plain words: "Module offline", "link is no longer active", modules that refuse (not ready, wrong request, locked, still busy), timeouts, coding that E-Sys cannot work out from the FA, and files E-Sys cannot read (often saved by a newer E-Sys) now say what happened and what to do.
- Fault scan: each fault shows how serious it is (a red, amber or grey dot), with counts at the top and a "Hide minor faults" switch that stays as you left it.
- Full backup shows its steps (FA, SVT, Coding, Files, Faults, FSC, Zip): what is done, what runs now and where it stopped.
- Job report: a module that did not finish is explained in plain words, with what to do.

Improved
- E-Sys dark look: one Dark look (the sharp one). Side bar icons sit right on the dark bar, buttons are dark with readable grey when off, and the ECU tree shows its folder icons and lines again.
- ECU tree: a double-click opens the module as before and no longer copies; a triple-click or Ctrl+C copies the line.
- Windows remember their size and place, on a second screen too, and never open bigger than the screen; a window that was on a screen that is gone opens on the main screen.
- Coding history keeps the list width and column widths you set, has arrows to scroll the versions, files each change under the day it first appeared, and Re-apply names its columns "Your value" and "Now".
- Updates: the download shows how far it is, picks up where it stopped, and says in plain words why it failed, with a "Download manually" button.
- Launcher top bar: Home, Settings, Badges and About next to the logo, your version and code at the right; "Copied" no longer stays stuck.
- The E-Sys title shows your screenshot code as "Code".
- Car recovery's empty lists say what to do.
- Many small fixes.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
